content_text:
Hey James,
Really hoping to grab a signed copy here in the UK – any chance Roger might pop by the BSC Expo? That would be amazing!
Also, gutted to report that my Amazon pre-order (placed ~6 months ago) just got cancelled out of the blue. Got an email saying earliest delivery is now Feb 2026, even though it was meant to ship today (Nov). Already spoken to Amazon support but they seem clueless.
Any chance you/your team could nudge Amazon about what’s going on? Would be hugely appreciated!
Thanks so much and congrats on the book!
